stay.kicker.yo: Ọjọ́ ìdìbò: Ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, 16 Oṣù Ṣẹ́rẹ́ (January) 2027

stay.hero-lede.en: Photograph the result posted at your polling unit. It becomes part of a public record anyone can check.
stay.hero-lede.ha: Ku ɗauki hoton sakamakon da aka liƙa a rukunin zaɓenku. Zai shiga littafin jama'a da kowa zai iya dubawa.
stay.hero-lede.ig: Seenụ foto nsonaazụ e gosiri ọha na ngalaba ntuli aka unu. Ọ ga-abụ akụkụ nke ndekọ ọha onye ọ bụla nwere ike ilele.
stay.hero-lede.yo: Ẹ ya fọ́tò àbájáde tí wọ́n lẹ̀ ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò yín. Yóò di ara àkọsílẹ̀ gbangba tí ẹnikẹ́ni lè ṣàyẹ̀wò.

stay.s1-sub.en: Hawkeye Election Monitor or Hawkeye Lite. Free on Google Play and the App Store.
stay.s1-sub.ha: Hawkeye Election Monitor ko Hawkeye Lite. Kyauta a Google Play da App Store.
stay.s1-sub.ig: Hawkeye Election Monitor ma ọ bụ Hawkeye Lite. N'efu na Google Play na App Store.
stay.s1-sub.yo: Hawkeye Election Monitor tàbí Hawkeye Lite. Ọ̀fẹ́ lórí Google Play àti App Store.

stay.s2-sub.en: The unit where you vote. Do it now, not on the day.
stay.s2-sub.ha: Inda kuke jefa ƙuri'a. Ku yi haka yanzu, ba a ranar zaɓe ba.
stay.s2-sub.ig: Ebe unu na-atụ vootu. Meenụ ya ugbu a, ọ bụghị n'ụbọchị ahụ.
stay.s2-sub.yo: Ibi tí ẹ ti ń dìbò. Ẹ ṣe é nísinsìnyí, kì í ṣe ní ọjọ́ ìdìbò.

stay.s3-sub.en: A few minutes, no sign-up, and nothing you enter is published.
stay.s3-sub.ha: 'Yan mintuna kawai, ba sai an yi rijista ba, kuma ba a wallafa komai da kuka shigar.
stay.s3-sub.ig: Nkeji ole na ole, ọ chọghị ndebanye aha, a naghịkwa ebipụta ihe ọ bụla unu tinyere.
stay.s3-sub.yo: Ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ péré, kò nílò ìforúkọsílẹ̀, a kì í sì í tẹ ohunkóhun tí ẹ bá tẹ̀ sí i jáde.

stay.d-stay-sub.en: Or come back before counting ends.
stay.d-stay-sub.ha: Ko ku dawo kafin a gama ƙidaya.
stay.d-stay-sub.ig: Ma ọ bụ laghachinụ tupu ọgụgụ agwụ.
stay.d-stay-sub.yo: Tàbí kí ẹ padà wá kí wọ́n tó parí ìkà.

stay.d-photo.en: When the result is posted, photograph it and submit
stay.d-photo.ha: Idan an liƙa sakamako, ku ɗauki hotonsa ku aika
stay.d-photo.ig: Mgbe e gosiri ọha nsonaazụ, seenụ ya foto ma zipu ya
stay.d-photo.yo: Nígbà tí wọ́n bá lẹ̀ àbájáde, ẹ ya fọ́tò rẹ̀ kí ẹ sì fi ránṣẹ́

stay.d-photo-sub.en: Photograph each result sheet: Presidential, Senate and House of Representatives.
stay.d-photo-sub.ha: Ku ɗauki hoton kowace takardar sakamako: ta Shugaban Ƙasa, ta Majalisar Dattawa da ta Majalisar Wakilai.
stay.d-photo-sub.ig: Seenụ foto mpempe akwụkwọ nsonaazụ ọ bụla: nke Onyeisiala, nke Sineti na nke Ụlọ Ndị Nnọchiteanya.
stay.d-photo-sub.yo: Ẹ ya fọ́tò ìwé àbájáde kọ̀ọ̀kan: ti Ààrẹ, ti Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà àti ti Ilé Aṣòfin Kékeré.

stay.d-offline.en: No signal? Hawkeye saves your report and sends it when you have signal.
stay.d-offline.ha: Babu yanar gizo? Hawkeye za ta ajiye rahotonku, ta aika da kanta idan kun dawo kan layi.
stay.d-offline.ig: Enweghị ịntanetị? Hawkeye ga-echekwa akụkọ unu ma ziga ya onwe ya mgbe netwọk laghachiri.
stay.d-offline.yo: Kò sí íńtánẹ́ẹ̀tì? Hawkeye yóò fi ìròyìn yín pamọ́, yóò sì fi ránṣẹ́ fúnra rẹ̀ nígbà tí íńtánẹ́ẹ̀tì bá dé.

stay.safety-h.en: No result is worth your life.
stay.safety-h.ha: Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranku daraja.
stay.safety-h.ig: Ọ dịghị nsonaazụ ọ bụla dị mkpa karịa ndụ unu.
stay.safety-h.yo: Kò sí àbájáde kankan tí ó ṣe pàtàkì ju ẹ̀mí yín lọ.

stay.safety-body.en: Follow electoral officials' instructions. Never interfere, never argue. Photograph only what is posted or handed out.
stay.safety-body.ha: Ku bi umarnin jami'an zaɓe. Kada ku tsoma baki, kada ku yi gardama. Ku ɗauki hoton abin da aka liƙa ko aka ba ku kawai.
stay.safety-body.ig: Soronụ ntụziaka ndị ọrụ ntuli aka. Unu etinyela aka n’ọrụ ha, unu esela okwu. Seenụ foto naanị ihe e gosiri ọha ma ọ bụ nke e nyere unu.
stay.safety-body.yo: Ẹ tẹ̀lé ìtọ́ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìdìbò. Ẹ má ṣe dí iṣẹ́ wọn lọ́wọ́, ẹ má sì bá ẹnikẹ́ni jiyàn. Ohun tí wọ́n lẹ̀ ní gbangba tàbí tí wọ́n fún yín nìkan ni kí ẹ ya fọ́tò rẹ̀.

stay.cert-s.en: Do the practice run, then answer 7 short questions.
stay.cert-s.ha: Ku yi gwajin atisaye, sannan ku amsa gajerun tambayoyi 7.
stay.cert-s.ig: Meenụ ọsọ omume, wee zaa ajụjụ mkpirikpi 7.
stay.cert-s.yo: Ẹ ṣe eré àdánwò, lẹ́yìn náà ẹ dáhùn ìbéèrè kúkúrú 7.

stay.captain-s.en: A ward captain makes sure someone stays for the count at every polling unit in one ward.
stay.captain-s.ha: Kyaftin na unguwa yana tabbatar da cewa wani ya tsaya domin ƙidaya a kowane rukunin zaɓe na unguwa ɗaya.
stay.captain-s.ig: Onye ndú ward na-ahụ na mmadụ nọrọ maka ọgụgụ na ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla dị n'otu ward.
stay.captain-s.yo: Olùdarí àgọ́ ń rí i dájú pé ẹnìkan dúró fún ìkà ní gbogbo ẹ̀ka ìdìbò ní àgọ́ kan.

stay.second-s.en: Two observers with the same numbers verify their unit's count. Open My Profile and tap Invite a Second Observer.
stay.second-s.ha: Masu lura biyu masu alkaluma iri ɗaya suna tabbatar da ƙidayar rukuninsu. Ku buɗe Bayanaina ku danna Gayyaci Mai Lura Na Biyu.
stay.second-s.ig: Ndị na-ekiri ihe abụọ nwere otu ọnụọgụ na-enyocha ngụkọ ngalaba ha. Mepee Profaịlụ M ma pịa Kpọọ Onye Na-ekiri Ihe Nke Abụọ.
stay.second-s.yo: Olùwòran méjì tí nọ́ńbà wọn bára mu ń fìdí ìkàyè ẹ̀ka wọn múlẹ̀. Ṣí Àkọọ́lẹ̀ Mi kí o sì tẹ Pe Olùwòran Kejì.

stay.coverage-s.en: Observer coverage by state and local government. It never shows who watches which unit.
stay.coverage-s.ha: Yawan rufewar masu lura bisa jiha da ƙaramar hukuma. Ba ya taɓa nuna wanda ke lura da wane rukuni.
stay.coverage-s.ig: Mkpuchi ndị na-ekiri ihe site na steeti na ọchịchị ime obodo. Ọ naghị egosi onye na-ekiri ngalaba ọ bụla.
stay.coverage-s.yo: Ìbòòrí àwọn olùwòran ní ìpínlẹ̀ àti ìjọba ìbílẹ̀. Kì í fi ẹni tó ń wo ẹ̀ka kọ̀ọ̀kan hàn.

press.date-pd1-s.en: National Practice Day. Observers across Nigeria run the same mock election, 08:00–18:00 WAT. Practice is never counted as a result.
press.date-pd1-s.ha: Ranar Atisaye ta Ƙasa. Masu lura a faɗin Najeriya za su yi zaɓen gwaji iri ɗaya, 08:00–18:00 WAT. Ba a taɓa ƙidaya atisaye a matsayin sakamako ba.
press.date-pd1-s.ig: Ụbọchị Omume nke Mba. Ndị na-ekiri ihe n’ofe Naịjirịa na-eme otu ntuli aka omume, 08:00–18:00 WAT. A naghị agụ omume dị ka nsonaazụ.
press.date-pd1-s.yo: Ọjọ́ Àdánwò Orílẹ̀-èdè. Àwọn olùwòran jákèjádò Nàìjíríà ń ṣe ìdìbò àdánwò kan náà, 08:00–18:00 WAT. A kì í ka àdánwò sí àbájáde.

press.data-r1-sub.en: About 0.4 MB of compressed photos per report, plus retries.
press.data-r1-sub.ha: Kusan MB 0.4 na hotuna da aka matsa a kowane rahoto, da sake gwadawa.
press.data-r1-sub.ig: Ihe dị ka MB 0.4 nke foto a kpakọrọ n'akụkọ ọ bụla, gbakwunyere mgbalị ọzọ.
press.data-r1-sub.yo: Nǹkan bí MB 0.4 fọ́tò tí a ti fún pọ̀ fún ìròyìn kọ̀ọ̀kan, pẹ̀lú àtúngbìyànjú.
